svg.title: Progress: 44 % of the functions work through the MCP
svg.desc: One square per function. 112 of 254 Solid Edge functions in the coverage map work through the MCP, 35 fail in Solid Edge 2026 and 107 are not tested yet. By area: Application, documents and data 26 of 46; Sketches and reference planes 11 of 22; Part (ordered modeling) 23 of 48; Synchronous modeling and surfaces 9 of 22; Sheet metal 13 of 27; Assemblies 15 of 40; Drawings 15 of 34; Program configuration 0 of 15.

g.text: of the 254 Solid Edge functions in the coverage map work through the MCP
